Stats are only shown during live matches. The button displays "NO LIVE MATCH" when your team isn't playing.
What you'll see: Possession, shots on target, and corners, shown as home vs away numbers. Your team's number is highlighted in teal. It refreshes on its own automatically. Stats availability depends on the API tier.
When on, pressing the button cycles through every visual state (live stats, no stats yet, no live match, etc.) using fake data, so you can check how each one looks. Turn off to go back to your real team.
